schema_version: 1
source_of_truth: docs/storage-and-delivery.md
engine: ClickHouse MergeTree
table: stat_events
migration_up: migrations/0001_init.up.sql
migration_down: migrations/0001_init.down.sql
columns:
  dimensions: [event_ts, user_id, role, session_id, course_id, course_version_id, lesson_id, task_id, platform, editor_mode, client_ts, event_type]
  payload: String containing serialized JSON
partition: event_date
order_by: [task_id, user_id, session_id, event_ts]
summary_scope: supplied_user_id
summary_semantics:
  session_start: minimum event_ts
  session_end: maximum event_ts
  typing_events: count of key_press and typing_stats
  reading_seconds: time before first typing event
  solving_seconds: total duration minus reading duration
  active_learning_seconds: sum of adjacent event gaps capped at 60 seconds per gap
  learning_session_counts: lessons, tasks, questions, selections, code runs, failures, passed tests, hints, interventions, and stuck observations
migration_runner:
  behavior: runs every sorted up migration
  tracking_table: none
  rollback_task: informational_only
legacy:
  course_version_id_request_field: not_supported
  course_version_id_storage_value: zero_uuid
